PDD acceleration requires ComfyUI 0.33.0 or newer.

## Optional: MiniMax H3 Latent Upscaler

Custom nodes:

https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler

Place the upscaler model in:

`ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`

The upscaler is optional. Disable or bypass its workflow section if the custom nodes or model are not installed.

## Optional: Prompt and Face Detail Extraction

Qwen3-VL text encoder:

Place it in the model directory expected by the loader used in this workflow, normally:

`ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`

This model is only required when using the prompt-extraction or face-detail section.

`ComfyUI/models/vae_approx/`

# Required Downloads

## MiniMax H3 Models

Model repository:

https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main

Place each model in its corresponding ComfyUI model directory:

- Diffusion models: `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`
- Text encoders: `ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/`
- VAE models: `ComfyUI/models/vae/`
- LoRAs: `ComfyUI/models/loras/`

## Required Custom Nodes

### AI Toolkit MiniMax H3

https://github.com/ostris/ComfyUI-AIToolkit-MiniMaxH3

Install into:

`ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-AIToolkit-MiniMaxH3/`

### H3 Overlap

https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_NAME/ComfyUI-H3-Overlap

Install into:

`ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-H3-Overlap/`

### VideoHelperSuite

https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

Required for loading and combining video.

## Optional: PDD Acceleration

Custom nodes:

https://github.com/Jalen-Brunson/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-PDD-Acc

Place PDD acceleration models in:

`ComfyUI/models/pdd_acc/`

Pre-converted PDD models:

https://huggingface.co/aptech0081/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs-ComfyUI

Example Ref2VA download:

https://huggingface.co/aptech0081/MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs-ComfyUI/resolve/main/minimax_h3_ref2va_pdd_acc_8step_comfyui.safetensors
